responsibility: Implements whole-number conversion between fixed CHAR arrays and INTEGER/CARDINAL values by composing WholeConv parsing/validation with StringConvert formatting and DynamicStrings copy-out helpers. It reports conversion status for StrToInt and StrToCard, and renders numeric values into caller buffers for IntToStr and CardToStr, making it the ARRAY OF CHAR front end for the whole-number conversion subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements ARRAY OF CHAR whole-number conversions: unlike the same-stem .def declaration file, it calls WholeConv Format*/Value* routines for parsing and uses StringConvert plus DynamicStrings.CopyOut to render numbers back into caller buffers.
